data.acquisitionSummary: Jio prepaid non-use is governed by Jio’s current regulatory policy, not a fixed Rs.199/90-day recharge rule. After 90 days of continuous non-use, a line with main-account balance above Rs.20 enters Automatic Number Retention: Rs.20 is deducted for each additional 30-day non-use period until balance falls below the threshold.

keep.action: After 90 days of continuous non-use, maintain sufficient main-account balance for Automatic Number Retention. Jio deducts Rs.20 per 30-day extension; ten such deductions cover the remaining ~275 days of a 365-day no-use horizon, consuming about Rs.200. Any qualifying usage resets the non-use clock.

data.chinaActivation: BLOCKER for typical remote acquisition: current Jio guidance sends new users to a Jio store/retailer with original identity and address documents. First-time IR activation should be prepared while the number is connected to the Jio network.
data.kyc: New SIM activation requires original Proof of Identity and Proof of Address; current Jio examples include Passport. Aadhaar biometric eKYC is a separate path. The reviewed official flow is India-centric/in-person rather than an overseas-first path.
data.payment: A usable prepaid plan is required for service; ongoing recharges/IR packs are managed through Jio channels. International payment acceptance is not relied on for this HOLD decision.
data.wifiCalling: Supported on compatible devices, but not relied on for retention.
data.roamingSms: Jio prepaid international roaming supports incoming SMS free of charge once IR is enabled. First-time IR preparation should be done while connected to the Jio network; an IR pack activates on first eligible foreign usage.
data.holdReason: Current retention is cheaper/more flexible than the old Rs.199/90-day model, but India-centric SIM activation/POI+POA and first-time IR preparation make overseas-first acquisition impractical.
data.tariffSummary: 90d non-use threshold, then Rs.20 automatic 30-day retention deductions while main balance is sufficient; incoming roaming SMS is free after IR setup.
guideSteps: Acquire/activate with valid POI+POA through the current Jio onboarding path.
Before travel, complete first-time international-roaming preparation while connected to Jio.
For pure non-use retention, keep enough main balance for Rs.20 automatic 30-day extensions after day 90.
